text:
You need an Excel-based financial model that can forecast revenue, expenses, cash flow, CAC, user growth, and scenario outcomes for a DeFi application, and I can help build that in a clear, decision-ready format.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, SQL, Power BI, Google Sheets, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. My background is well suited to building structured models that combine financial logic with clean input assumptions, sensitivity analysis, and presentation-ready outputs for stakeholders.

In a recent project, I built a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel. The work replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports with one Power BI report built on a star-schema model, and it reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That project required careful data modeling, formula discipline, and translating messy operational data into a reliable reporting structure.

I also built a Dental clinic expansion model for Sunrise Dental Partners in Excel. That model compared three sites using best, base, and worst-case scenarios for patient volume and staffing, and it helped identify a site projected to pay back in 14 months. That experience aligns closely with the kind of scenario-based forecasting and sensitivity analysis your DeFi application needs.

For your project, I would focus on building a robust Excel model that clearly separates assumptions, calculations, and outputs. I can structure projections for revenue streams such as membership fees and transaction fees, incorporate CAC logic across acquisition channels and conversion rates, and model retention and user growth assumptions in a way that is easy to update. I can also build scenario analysis to show how changes in acquisition, retention, and revenue drivers affect cash flow and overall performance.

I’m comfortable working with large datasets and turning them into practical models that support planning and investment decisions. While my experience is strongest in Excel-based modeling, reporting, and analytics, I bring a careful, analytical approach that fits well with financial projection work.

If you’d like, I can help create a model that is both rigorous and easy for your team to maintain as the business evolves.
